programme.title: Hannes Aan Huis

programme.title: Drukkoker
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Die strategiese spel het begin. Ashley en René, die vierde vennootskap aan die beurt, moet krag en slimmigheid wys ná 'n besoek aan 'n ikoniese restaurant. Sal hulle die span kan lei of sal die druk te veel word?

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S30/E13'. Oak Valley is 'n boerdery in die Elgin-vallei waarop die eerste kommersiële appelboorde gevestig is. Christopher Rawbone-Viljoen (vyfde geslag) is aan die stuur van sake waar vrugte, blomme en ook wyn hoogty vier.

programme.title: Die Wynmeester
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Die wynmakers se vaardigheide om 'n etiket te ontwerp en 'n wynbottel af te rond, word dié week op Die Wynmeester getoets. Bottelering en etikettering word ook van naderby ondersoek.

programme.title: Gekies Vir Die Kollig!
programme.desc: 'S5/E2'. Marlo Minnaar is 'n mentor wat stories aan die brand kan steek met net 'n kyk. Sy span is Moya Erasmus, net 17 jaar oud, en Eduard de Villiers, wat jou verwagtings kom ruk.

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S2/E8'. Tannie Chandre Lesch bring stories van huis en spicy kos. Aneeka begin met 'n bubble tea mocktail en saam maak hulle 'n Mexikaanse tafel vol geur en gevoel.

programme.title: Bietjie Brittanje
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Mia Vorster bly in die Verenigde Koningkryk. In dié reeks besoek sy ander Suid-Afrikaners wat nou ook hier nesskrop en saam gesels hulle oor hul twee wêrelde.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Boompie Alleen: Hierdie week is ons in Vrede in die Vrystaat en ontmoet die Fourie-familie, wat al vir vyf generasies met beeste en sojabone boer.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E13'. Denise, Andrew en Retief ding teen mekaar mee om nie net as wenner uit die stryd te tree nie, maar ook om stewige geldpotte op te bou. Wie gaan mekaar die beste opsom om dit tot hul guns te gebruik?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E14'. Madre, Chrisna en Francois pak mekaar in hierdie uitdunronde. Hulle kry die geleentheid om hul geldpotte te vergroot, maar ook om verder te vorder op Wie weet wat.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E15'. Natalie, Annerine en Fred kom in hierdie uitdrunronde teen mekaar te staan. 'n Bietjie slinksheid gaan saam met slimheid ingespan moet word om die oorhand oor mekaar te kry. Daar is ook heelwat rande om te wen.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E16'. Chrisna, Fred en Retief is terug op Wie weet wat. Hierdie keer sal hulle nie net wil verbeter op hoe hulle vaar nie, maar ook in hoe die geldpotte aan die einde van die episode gaan lyk.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S17/E13'. Die kole gloei in Bellville en die Paarl! Juan en Elizabeth braai lamtjops en hoendersosaties. Casily en Bonita bedien varktjops en hoender, en Jayleev en Lance gooi lamtjops en gemarineerde hoender op die kole.

programme.desc: 'S10/E6'. Frank vang op met CJ Stander oor sy rugby-reis van SA na Ierland. Ons ondersoek hoekom mans sukkel om te gesels oor emosies, restoureer 'n tuinbank, en loer in by Boer & Butcher.

programme.desc: 'S6/E7'. Carmen Moller leef met sistiese fibrose en SF-verwante diabetes, maar sy lewe volwaardig. Lamelle wys 'n behandeling wat op almal se salon-lysie hoort, en Herman maak harissa-forel met suurlemoen-koeskoes.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 'S4/E27'. The Nissan GTR is a more affordable direct competitor to Porsche's 911 Turbo S or the Audi R8 GT. One of the ultimate super cars, the Techart 911 Turbo S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 'S5/E1'. Only few sports cars can match the fascination that surrounds the McLaren brand. In France we encountered the British convertible Bentley GTC V8 S.

programme.title: Sold In 60 Seconds
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - 1/4'. Get a taste of la dolce vita in an adorable Fiat 500 Abarth. The Jaguar E-type proves it's as popular as ever and a rare Chevy Corvette provides a spectacular grand finale.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S25/E48'. Is the Subaru Forester the C-SUV segment's best kept secret? Volvo gives the evergreen XC 90 a new lease of life and we chat to Marinus Venter of Changan SA.

programme.title: Stoos & Crafted
programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. We meet up with talented handcraft artists Jarred and Rickus in Mossel Bay. Alex finishes up the collaboration monster build and sees what's been happening in the workshop.

programme.title: Start Me Up
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Martin is determined to resurrect a this 1944 Willys Jeep. MOD rides on Lloyd military personnel carrier and checks out some rare metal, including a 250HP Mazda RX3.

programme.title: Auto Mundial
programme.desc: 'S25/E48'. This week's design-focused episode covers Alfa Romeo's latest supercar, critiques the new Renault Clio's styling, and explores Audi's familiar-looking future concept.

programme.title: Rev
programme.desc: 'S25/E48'. Malta's iconic hand-painted buses, once central to daily travel, now survive only as restored showpieces. We join police on speed patrol and test the VinFast VF 6.

programme.title: FIA Karting
programme.desc: 'S5/E4'. FIA Karting hits Viterbo for Round 3: Avril dominates Academy Senior, Hugon claims surprise OK-J win, and Costoya unstoppable in OK. Title fights heat up before Rodby finale!

programme.title: Toyota Gazoo Racing SA Cup
programme.desc: 'S25/E7'. Once again, the Toyota Gazoo Racing GR Cup produced thrills and spills in the final round of the 2025 series held at the Zwartkops Raceway.

programme.title: Fast Lane
programme.desc: 'S2/E11'. On and off track with the hottest figures in F1 including Lewis Hamilton´s tour of Shanghai and the drivers' best friends... and it´s not what you think.

programme.title: Kasi Car Culture
programme.desc: 'S4/E8'. We celebrate the passion behind SA's vibrant township car culture. It's not only about what people drive, but also about the unique sense of community that surrounds them.

programme.title: Giving it Gears with Jason Goliath

programme.title: The IGNITION Giveaway Show

programme.desc: 'S5/E2'. Jaguar's supercharged V8 XF RS Sportbreak, the Porsche Panamera Turbo S and the Audi S8 combine space and comfort with the performance of a sports car. We compare these 3 contenders.

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Prologue
programme.desc: Prologue. Luca Braidot and Simone Avondetto won the 2025 Prologue. They excelled in the 26km time trial under hot, dry conditions. The stage featured sharp climbs and sweeping singletrack descents.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1. Nino Schurter and Filippo Colombo won stage 1, taking the overall lead. Annika Langvad & Sofia Gomez Villafane extended their lead in the women's race.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 2
programme.desc: Stage 2. Nino Schurter & Filippo Colombo won stage 2 by maintaining their lead along with Annika Langvad & Sofia Gomez Villafane. Technical trails & steep climbs challenged all riders.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3. Nino Schurter and Filippo Colombo won stage 3. This stage featured rewarding singletracks and challenging ascents.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4. Nino Schurter & Filippo Colombo won the stage, maintaining their overall lead. Scorching heat and rocky outcrops tested riders' endurance.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5. Nino Schurter & Filippo Colombo won stage 5. Annika Langvad and Sofia Gomez Villafane extended their lead in the women's race.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 6
programme.desc: Stage 6. Nino Schurter & Filippo Colombo won the stage. Also Annika Langvad & Sofia Gomez Villafane extended their lead in the women's race. This stage featured rewarding singletracks & challenging ascents.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic HL '25: Stage 7
programme.desc: Stage 7. Nino Schurter and Filippo Colombo won the stage, securing the overall victory. This stage featured breathtaking views and challenging terrain.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 1981 (W) Final
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 1981 Women's Final: Chris Evert vs Martina Navratilova'. Martina Navratilova defeated Chris Evert in the final, to win the women's singles title. It was her first title and third major singles title overall.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 1993 (W) Final
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 1993 Women's Final: Monica Seles vs Steffi Graf'. Two-time defending champion Monica Seles defeated Steffi Graf in the final to win the women's singles tennis title. It was Seles' third Australian Open title.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2008 (M) Final
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 2008 Men's Final: Novak Djokovic vs Jo-Wilfried Tsonga'. Novak Djokovic defeated unseeded Jo-Wilfried Tsonga in the final to win the Men's Singles tennis title. It was his first Grand Slam title.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2017 (M) SF
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 2017 Men's Semi-final: Roger Federer vs Stan Wawrinka'. Roger Federer saw off a comeback from Stan Wawrinka to beat the world No4 and reach his 28th grand slam final.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2024 (W) Rnd 2
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 2024 Women's Round 2: Anna Blinkova vs Elena Rybakina'. Rybakina defeated in longest-ever grand slam tiebreaker. Blinkova was a break up in all three sets but third-ranked Rybakina rallied each time.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2024 (M) Final
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Classics - 2024 Men's Final: Jannik Sinner vs Daniil Medvedev'. Jannik Sinner landed the Grand Slam title he has long promised with an extraordinary fightback to beat Daniil Medvedev.
